units.source_text: 我对夫人的理解力很佩服，她那不同于旧式日本妇女的做派，也给予我某种刺激。

en.t: I admired the wife's understanding, and her manner, unlike that of old-fashioned Japanese women, also gave me a certain stimulation.

units.source_text: 夫人几乎没有使用过当时流行起来的所谓的时髦词儿。

en.t: The wife almost never used the so-called fashionable words that were coming into vogue at the time.

units.source_text: 我是个从未与女人有过深交的古板青年，

en.t: I was a stiff, inexperienced young man who had never been deeply acquainted with women,

units.source_text: 只是出于男人对异性的本能，常常怀着憧憬，梦想女人，

en.t: and only from a man's instinct toward the opposite sex, I often dreamed of women with longing,

units.source_text: 但那不过是眺望令人眷恋的春云般的心情，朦胧的梦想而已，

en.t: but that was no more than a hazy dream, like the feeling of gazing at beloved spring clouds,

units.source_text: 所以一旦面对女人，我的感情往往会突然变化。

en.t: so once I actually faced a woman, my feelings would often change suddenly.

units.source_text: 但是我不会被出现在自己面前的女人所吸引，越是这种时候，我越会产生奇妙的逆反心理。

en.t: But I would not be drawn to a woman who appeared before me; at such times, all the more, a strange contrary feeling would arise in me.

units.source_text: 可面对夫人时，却丝毫没有这种感觉，也从未感觉到横亘在男女之间的那种思想上的差距。

en.t: Yet when I faced the wife, I never felt that at all, nor did I ever feel the kind of mental gap that lies between men and women.

units.source_text: 我忘记了夫人是个女人，我只是把夫人看作先生忠实的批评者和同情者。

en.t: I forgot that the wife was a woman; I saw her only as Sensei's faithful critic and sympathizer.

units.source_text: “夫人，前些日子我问您，先生为什么不参与些社会活动时，您当时说，他原来不是这样的。”

en.t: "Madam, the other day, when I asked you why Sensei did not take part in social activities, you said then that he had not originally been like this."
"I did say that. He truly was not like this."

units.source_text: “就像你所希望的那样，也像我所希望的那样，他是个有抱负的人。”

en.t: "Just as you would hope, and just as I would hope, he was a man with ambition."

units.source_text: “不是突然，是逐渐变成这样的。”

en.t: "It was not sudden. He gradually became this way."

units.source_text: “那期间，夫人一直同先生在一起吧？”

en.t: "During that time, Madam, you were always together with Sensei, were you not?"

units.source_text: “当然在一起啦，我们是夫妇啊。”

en.t: "Of course I was. We are husband and wife, after all."

units.source_text: “那么先生变成这样的原因，您应当很清楚了。”

en.t: "Then you ought to know very well why Sensei became this way."
